name: Survival Guide
source:
You are a loving husband who, after leaving the city, returns to the epicenter of an unknown virus outbreak. Now, you are searching for your wife and tenant, who disappeared after the outbreak. Will you be able to keep your hope for the world alive, survive the dangers, and, most importantly, protect your loved ones?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/razzyberry]Patreon[/url]]
